alt: A 100-point bar split into 35 points the checker recomputes by running the code on hidden test cases, 42 points (12 + 30) read from the submission's own results file and never verified, and 23 points from other checks (code text 3, behaviour monitor 8, report keywords 12). A box explains that a sound fix would need the checker to recompute the 42 points itself, and a note mentions a second, fixed problem: one of two allowed method forms was penalised (88.92 against 42.86 out of 100 for the same strong work).
caption: 42 of the 100 points come from numbers the submission reports about its own work, which the checker never verifies, so the task was removed. The agent implements the D-ABIC gravity inversion method; the checker recomputes only 35 points by running the code on hidden test cases and scores two parts, worth 12 and 30 points, from the submission's own results file as written. A sound fix would need the checker to recompute those 42 points from hidden data itself. A second problem, a hidden penalty on one of two allowed, equivalent method forms (88.92 against 42.86 out of 100 for the same strong work, computed from the checker's own rule), was fixed but did not save the task.
